description: A script to run web page load experiments using either wget or a custom quic_client, fetching URLs from a JSON file, measuring delays and packet counts, and saving results to CSV files.

classes.name: PageloadExperiment
classes.description: Class to perform page load experiments using wget or quic_client, including reading URL pages from JSON, downloading pages, and recording delays and packet counts.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds or converts a given datetime to timestamp.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the experiment with options for using wget, binary directory, server address, and port.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.ReadPages
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns a list of URL lists for each page, including resources.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.DownloadOnePage
methods.description: Downloads a page (list of URLs) using wget or quic_client, returning download time and max packet number.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.RunExperiment
methods.description: Runs the experiment for a specified number of iterations, saving delay and packet data to CSV files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to parse command-line options, initialize the experiment, and run it.
